title: Umami Rich Kenyan Chuck Roast Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful Kenyan-inspired stew featuring tender chuck roast, namul-blanch-seasoned vegetables, and a rich umami broth, perfect for a cozy dinner
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat
Add the chuck roast cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes
Remove the browned chuck roast from the pot and set aside
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes
Add the tomato paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute
Add the beef broth, soy sauce, and browned chuck roast to the pot
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley
